events.address: Sephora SoHo, 557 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A two-day Medik8 skincare pop-up inside Sephora SoHo with personalized consultations, complimentary samples and giveaways. September 16 also includes an Ariana Madix meet-and-greet with separate purchase/wristband eligibility.
events.what_is_free: Pop-up access, personalized skincare consultations, samples and giveaways are complimentary. The Ariana Madix meet-and-greet is not a general free-access benefit: it is limited to the first 150 eligible customers who buy two or more full-size Medik8 products on September 16 and receive a wristband.
events.caveats: Partiful explicitly says a ticket does not guarantee entry on September 16 and attendance remains subject to eligibility/store rules. Do not imply the Ariana Madix meet-and-greet is included with ordinary RSVP; it requires the qualifying purchase and one of the first 150 wristbands. Celebrity appearance is subject to change.
events.practical_notes: September 16 pop-up runs 12–5:30 PM, followed by the separately qualified Ariana Madix meet-and-greet 6–8 PM. September 17 pop-up runs 11 AM–7 PM with consultations, samples and giveaways.

events.what_it_is: TEMPTATIONS' first Cat Bodega, a free immersive bodega-inspired pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats with product sampling, games, scratch-offs, merchandise prizes and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free. Visitors can sample free TEMPTATIONS treats and play games including a claw machine and scratch-offs for chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: Official TEMPTATIONS/Mars material describes the physical NYC pop-up as free and gives the same 12–6 PM daily schedule. Treats and merchandise/prizes are subject to availability/chance; the virtual Cat Bodega is a separate nationwide extension.
events.practical_notes: Open September 17, 18 and 19 from 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle / Meatpacking Plaza, 9th Ave between W 14th and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for the new Vitamin Enriched Face Base+, with product discovery, complimentary samples, refreshments, croissants, scratch-off giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Face Base+ samples, refreshments/snacks and scratch-off giveaway opportunities while supplies last. The first 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: Eventbrite is organized by Bobbi Brown Cosmetics and lists the event as free. Samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last. Photo/video content will be captured for Bobbi Brown social/digital use.
events.practical_notes: Thursday September 17 only, 12–6 PM. First 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample.
